❗️ Russia is currently employing a tactic aimed at destroying power grids and transmission lines, President Zelenskyy said. Russia is attempting to cut off the Odesa and Dnipropetrovsk regions from energy sources, the President stated. “In Odesa, power has been restored to critical infrastructure, and every effort is being made to secure alternative supply sources. Work is underway in Dnipro, Kamianske, the Kharkiv region, and the Poltava region. The necessary equipment and resources for repairs are available. Our energy workers are highly professional; it is important to note that they always strive to restore supply—always. The military has also been assigned specific tasks to counter this new Russian tactic,” the President explained.
